tools.name: pdf_info
tools.description: Page count, page sizes, metadata, encryption and form fields of a PDF.

tools.name: pdf_merge
tools.description: Joins PDFs into one, in the order given. Each input can pick its pages ("1-3, 5, 8-").

overwrite.description: Replace the output file if it exists

tools.name: pdf_split
tools.description: Splits a PDF into several files: one per range ("1-3, 4-6") or every N pages.

ranges.description: Comma-separated groups, each becomes a file, e.g. "1-3, 4, 5-"

every.description: Pages per file, when no ranges are given (default 1)

outputDir.description: Folder for the parts (default: next to the input)

overwrite.description: Replace the output file if it exists

tools.name: pdf_organize
tools.description: Builds a new PDF from the pages listed, in that order (pages left out are deleted), optionally rotating some of them.

pages.description: New page order, e.g. "3, 1-2, 5-" (default: all pages)

rotatePages.description: Original page numbers to rotate (default: all)

overwrite.description: Replace the output file if it exists

tools.name: pdf_edit
tools.description: Adds a text watermark and/or page numbers, sets metadata, and protects with a password. With `password` and no `protect`, the output is an unlocked copy.

metadata.description: Replaces the document info; fields left out are cleared

overwrite.description: Replace the output file if it exists

tools.name: pdf_form_read
tools.description: Lists the fillable (AcroForm) fields of a PDF with their type, current value and options.

tools.name: pdf_form_fill
tools.description: Writes values into fillable fields (names from pdf_form_read). Diacritics are supported.

values.description: Field name -> value; checkboxes take true/false

flatten.description: Make the values part of the page (default true)

overwrite.description: Replace the output file if it exists

tools.name: pdf_to_excel
tools.description: Finds tables in a PDF from its text layout and writes them to .xlsx (or .csv). Works on statements, price lists and reports; not on scans.

output.description: .xlsx or .csv; default <name>.xlsx next to the input

layout.description: One sheet per page (default) or per table

numbers.description: Number format: auto, 1.234,56 (comma), 1,234.56 (dot) or keep as text

includeText.description: Keep text outside tables (page layout only, default true)

overwrite.description: Replace the output file if it exists

tools.name: pdf_to_word
tools.description: Rebuilds the text of a PDF as an editable .docx: paragraphs, headings, bold and italic. Tables and columns come out as paragraphs; scanned pages are skipped.

overwrite.description: Replace the output file if it exists

tools.name: pdf_sign
tools.description: Places a signature, stamp or logo image (a transparent PNG works best; JPEG, WebP and AVIF too) on chosen pages, at a corner or at exact millimetres, keeping its proportions. This is a visible signature, not a cryptographic (digital certificate) one.

pages.description: Page ranges, e.g. "1, 3-5"; default the last page

xMM.description: Left edge from the page’s left, in mm (instead of position)

yMM.description: Bottom edge from the page’s bottom, in mm

overwrite.description: Replace the output file if it exists

tools.name: office_to_pdf
tools.description: Converts .docx, .xlsx, .pptx or .odp to PDF without Office installed. Layout is redrawn, so it is close to but not identical with Office output; GIF/WebP/BMP pictures show as placeholders.

tools.name: document_anonymize
tools.description: Finds personal data in a .docx or text file (or in `text`) and replaces it: names after titles and court roles (Mr., Frau, domnul, reclamantul…), addresses, national ID numbers checked by their control digit (CNP, PESEL, EGN, TC Kimlik, DNI/NIE, codice fiscale, NIR, SSN, NINO, rodné číslo), ID card and passport numbers, dates of birth, e-mails, phones, IBANs and cards, licence plates and IPs; companies and places on request. The same person always gets the same label ([Person 1]). Word files keep their formatting; author fields are cleared. Rules only (no AI model), so names with no title before them are found only when they also appear after one, or via `terms`. The originals are never returned: only counts, so the result can be shown to a model safely. Run it before reading a confidential file.

style.description: label: [Person 1] (default); initials: P.I. for names; mask: █████

hide.description: Kinds to hide; default all but organization and location

terms.description: Words or phrases to hide everywhere too (names, nicknames, case numbers)

keep.description: Found values to leave as they are (e.g. the court, the lawyer)

language.description: Language of the labels ([Persoana 1], [Person 1]...); default en

output.description: Where to write the result; default <name>-anonymized next to the input

key_output.description: Also write a CSV key (label -> original) here, to reverse it later. Keep it apart from the document.

tools.name: legal_deadline
tools.description: The last day of a procedural or legal time limit, with each counting step explained. Systems: ro-civil (Romanian Civil Procedure Code art. 181-183, clear days: neither first nor last day counts), ro-criminal (CPP art. 269, same), ro-custody (CPP art. 271, preventive measures: both ends count, no holiday extension), ro-civil-code (Civil Code art. 2551-2553, limitation periods), eu (Regulation 1182/71), generic (calendar or working days). A last day on a weekend or public holiday moves to the next working day. Public holidays are computed for any year for: RO, BG, DE, AT, FR, BE, NL, ES, IT, PT, PL, CZ, SK, HU, GB, IE, US (GB = England and Wales, US = federal).

start.description: YYYY-MM-DD: the day the term runs from (service, judgment, event); for direction "before", the hearing date

unit.description: workingDays only for eu and generic; ro-custody counts days or months

direction.description: "before": at least N clear days before `start` (ro-civil and ro-criminal, days only)

country.description: Holidays to skip: RO, BG, DE, AT, FR, BE, NL, ES, IT, PT, PL, CZ, SK, HU, GB, IE, US, or "" for weekends only; default RO for Romanian systems, none otherwise

days_off.description: Extra closed days (regional holidays, court closures)

extend.description: generic only: move a closed last day to the next working day (default true)

language.description: Language of the explanation; default en

tools.name: legal_letter
tools.description: Writes a ready-to-send letter citing the right articles: GDPR requests (gdprAccess art. 15, gdprRectification art. 16, gdprErasure art. 17, gdprObjection art. 21, gdprPortability art. 20, gdprConsent art. 7(3)), a formalNotice to pay (in Romanian it cites art. 1522 Civil Code and art. 1014 CPC) or a powerOfAttorney, in any of 14 languages, as PDF, .docx or plain text. Fields left empty show as ________ and are listed in the reply.

language.description: Language of the letter; default en

id.description: ID document, power of attorney only

sender.description: Who writes (the principal, for a power of attorney)

fields.description: Document fields: gdprAccess: reference, copy (check), details (textarea); gdprRectification: reference, incorrect (textarea), correct (textarea); gdprErasure: reference, groundNotNeeded (check), groundConsent (check), groundObjection (check), groundUnlawful (check), details (textarea); gdprObjection: reference, marketing (check), reasons (textarea); gdprPortability: reference, newController; gdprConsent: processing, reference; formalNotice: amount (number), currency (currency), basis, dueDate (date), payDays (number), iban, interest (check); powerOfAttorney: agentName, agentAddress, agentId, powers (textarea), validUntil (date). Dates YYYY-MM-DD; check fields true/false; currency is an ISO code.

output.description: .pdf, .docx or .txt path; without it the text is returned

tools.name: efactura_read
tools.description: Reads a Romanian e-Factura (UBL 2.1 XML, or the .zip downloaded from ANAF SPV) and checks that its totals add up (EN 16931 BR-CO rules). Does not validate against the ANAF schema.

full.description: Return the whole parsed model instead of a summary

tools.name: efactura_to_pdf
tools.description: Turns an e-Factura XML (or every invoice in an ANAF .zip) into a readable A4 PDF.

outputDir.description: Default: next to the input; files are named factura-<number>.pdf

tools.name: cv_to_pdf
tools.description: Typesets a CV with XeLaTeX (TeX Live 2026) on this machine and writes the PDF. Give structured `cv` data for the Classic, Modern or Academic template (Academic: Latin Modern with small caps, a skills table, education grouped by school), or your own LaTeX in `tex`/`texFile`. Projects and awards take one line as a paragraph, several as bullets. Only bundled packages are available (fontspec, geometry, xcolor, enumitem, titlesec, hyperref, tabularx, multicol, paracol, fontawesome5 and their dependencies); fonts: Linux Libertine, Biolinum, Latin Modern. The first call downloads the engine (~21 MB) from app.ionelul.com and caches it; the CV is never sent anywhere.

details.description: One bullet per line, or a list
One bullet per line, or a list
One bullet per line, or a list
One bullet per line, or a list

lang.description: Language of the section titles (default en)

texFile.description: Path to a .tex file instead of `cv`

output.description: PDF path. Default: <texFile>.pdf, or cv.pdf in the current folder

saveTex.description: Also write the .tex next to the PDF (default false)

tools.name: image_strip_metadata
tools.description: Removes EXIF (GPS, camera, dates), XMP, IPTC and comments from JPEG, PNG and WebP without re-encoding: pixels stay byte for byte. Rotated photos keep only their orientation.

tools.name: file_checksum
tools.description: Hashes files (streamed, so large files are fine) and optionally verifies them against an expected hash or a checksum file (sha256sum, md5sum or BSD format).

checksumFile.description: SHA256SUMS-style file to verify against, by file name

tools.name: romanian_diacritics
tools.description: Adds missing Romanian diacritics (ă â î ș ț) from a dictionary of ~70,000 words, fixes the old cedilla letters (ş ţ to ș ț), or removes diacritics. With `add`, words that can be spelled more than one way get the most common form and are listed with their alternatives.

file.description: Read the text from this file instead (UTF-8)

mode.description: add: put diacritics in; fix: ş ţ to ș ț; remove: strip them

output.description: Write the result to this file instead of returning it

tools.name: text_stats
tools.description: Counts words, characters (with and without spaces), sentences, paragraphs, lines and unique words; reading and speaking time; top keywords with their density.

file.description: Read the text from this file instead (UTF-8)

tools.name: text_case
tools.description: Converts text to a case (upper, lower, sentence, title, capitalize, inverse, alternating, camel, pascal, snake, constant, kebab, dot) or cleans it up (trim spaces, collapse blank lines, join lines, unwrap lines broken by PDF copies, straight quotes, sort, dedupe or reverse lines). Locale-aware (Turkish i, Romanian ș).

file.description: Read the text from this file instead (UTF-8)

lang.description: BCP 47 language for case rules, e.g. "tr", "ro" (default en)

output.description: Write the result to this file instead of returning it

tools.name: text_diff
tools.description: Line-by-line comparison of two texts or files, as a unified diff (like `diff -u`), with the number of lines added and removed.

ignoreWhitespace.description: Ignore spaces at the start and end of lines

context.description: Unchanged lines shown around each change (default 3)

tools.name: base64
tools.description: Encodes text or any file to Base64 (optionally URL-safe or wrapped at 76 columns, e.g. for data: URLs and e-mail), decodes Base64 back to text or to a file, and percent-encodes or decodes URLs.

file.description: Read the text from this file instead (UTF-8)

fullUrl.description: URL modes: keep : / ? # & = (encodeURI) instead of encoding a single component

output.description: Write the result here; needed when decoded bytes are not text

tools.name: password_generate
tools.description: Generates passwords, passphrases (EFF long word list, 7,776 words) or PINs with a cryptographically secure random generator, without modulo bias, and reports their entropy and strength.

noAmbiguous.description: Leave out I l 1 | O 0 o and quotes

number.description: Add a digit to one passphrase word

tools.name: uuid
tools.description: Generates random UUIDs (v4) or time-ordered ones (v7, sortable by creation time), or inspects a UUID: its version, variant and, for v7, the time it was made.

inspect.description: A UUID to read instead of generating

tools.name: markdown_to_html
tools.description: Converts Markdown (GitHub flavour: tables, task lists, fenced code) to an HTML fragment, or to a complete styled HTML page titled after the first heading.

file.description: Read the text from this file instead (UTF-8)

page.description: A full HTML document with styles (default true)

output.description: Default: <file>.html next to a Markdown file; otherwise returned

tools.name: regex_test
tools.description: Runs a JavaScript regular expression on a text: every match with its position and capture groups (numbered and named), and optionally the text with a replacement applied.

file.description: Read the text from this file instead (UTF-8)

tools.name: regex_generate
tools.description: Writes a JavaScript regular expression, without AI: from examples of what should (and optionally should not) match, worked out run by run and checked on every example; or from a description, picked from a library of common patterns (email, URL, IP, IBAN, Romanian CNP/CUI/plates/phones, dates, times, money, UUID...); or from a format such as "DD.MM.YYYY" or "AA 99 AAA" (9 a digit, A an upper-case letter, a lower-case, X letter or digit, DD/MM/YYYY/HH/mm date and time parts, \ for a literal).

whole.description: Match whole values with ^...$ (default true); false finds the pattern inside text

description.description: What to match, in words (any language) or as a format like DD.MM.YYYY

tools.name: text_summarize
tools.description: Extractive summary in any language: the sentences that best stand for the whole text (TextRank on TF-IDF), word for word and in their original order. No AI model, nothing invented.

file.description: Read the text from this file instead (UTF-8)

share.description: Share of the sentences to keep (default 0.25)

output.description: Write the summary to this file instead of returning it

tools.name: lorem_ipsum
tools.description:
Placeholder text: paragraphs, sentences or words, optionally starting with the classic "Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet" and wrapped in

tags.

tools.name: unit_convert
tools.description: Converts a value between units of one category, including temperature and fuel economy. Units by id: length: m, km, cm, mm, um, mi, yd, ft, in, nmi; mass: kg, g, mg, t, lb, oz, st, ct; volume: l, ml, m3, cm3, galus, galuk, qt, pt, cup, floz, tbsp, tsp; area: m2, km2, ha, cm2, mi2, ac, yd2, ft2, in2; temperature: c, f, k; speed: ms, kmh, mph, kn, fts, mach; time: ms, s, min, h, d, wk, mo, yr; data: bit, B, KB, MB, GB, TB, PB, KiB, MiB, GiB, TiB; energy: j, kj, cal, kcal, wh, kwh, btu, ev; power: w, kw, mw, hp, ps, btuh; pressure: pa, kpa, mpa, bar, mbar, atm, psi, mmhg; angle: deg, rad, grad, turn; fuel: kml, l100, mpgus, mpguk.

to.description: Unit id; leave out to get every unit of the category

tools.name: timestamp_convert
tools.description: Turns a Unix timestamp (seconds, ms, µs or ns, detected by length) or a wall-clock date and time in a zone into the instant in UTC, the time in other IANA zones (with daylight saving) and every timestamp unit. With nothing given it uses now.

date.description: Wall time "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm[:ss]" in `zone`, instead of a timestamp

zones.description: Zones to show the instant in (default UTC and this machine’s zone)

tools.name: color_convert
tools.description: Converts a colour (hex, rgb(), hsl(), hwb(), hsv(), cmyk(), lab(), lch(), oklab(), oklch(); not CSS names) to every format. With `background`, gives the WCAG 2 contrast ratio, the AA/AAA verdicts and, when it fails, the nearest colour that passes. Can add a tint/shade scale and harmonies.

target.description: Contrast ratio to fix towards (default 4.5, AA for normal text)

scale.description: Nine tints and shades, light to dark

tools.name: qr_create
tools.description: Makes a QR code as SVG (styled dots and eyes, any size) or PNG (square modules) from text, a link, Wi-Fi login, e-mail, phone, SMS, contact card, location or calendar event. Fields per type: url: url; text: text; wifi: ssid, password, security, hidden; email: to, subject, body; phone: phone; sms: phone, message; vcard: firstName, lastName, phone, email, company, title, website, street, city, zip, country; location: lat, lng; event: title, start, end, location, description. UTF-8, so diacritics and emoji work.

text.description: Shortcut for type text / the url of type url

tools.name: barcode_create
tools.description: Makes a barcode as SVG (sized in mm, prints at exact size) or PNG (at a DPI, written into the file): EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A, UPC-E, ISBN, Code 128, Code 39, Code 93, ITF-14, Interleaved 2 of 5, GS1-128, Codabar, Data Matrix, GS1 Data Matrix, PDF417 and Aztec. EAN/UPC check digits are added when left out.

moduleMM.description: Narrowest bar in mm (default per type, e.g. 0.33 for EAN)

tools.name: code_read
tools.description: Finds and decodes every QR code, Micro QR, Data Matrix, Aztec, PDF417 and 1D barcode (EAN, UPC, Code 128/39/93, ITF, Codabar, DataBar) in a PNG, JPEG, GIF or BMP image, and explains the content: Wi-Fi login, contact card, event, payment, GS1 fields, product code or link (with its domain).

tools.name: image_convert
tools.description: Re-encodes JPEG, PNG, WebP and AVIF images with the Squoosh codecs (MozJPEG, OxiPNG, libwebp, libavif): convert between formats, compress at a quality, and shrink to a maximum width/height or a percentage (Lanczos3, aspect kept, never enlarged). Metadata is not carried over.

background.description: Fill for transparent pixels when writing JPEG (default #ffffff)

tools.name: image_to_svg
tools.description: Traces a JPEG, PNG, WebP or AVIF into an SVG of filled paths (imagetracerjs). Best for logos, icons, drawings and scans with few colours. Presets: logo (8 colours), detailed (48), mono (black and white), gray, smooth.

tools.name: images_to_pdf
tools.description: Puts images into one PDF, one per page, in the order given: A4 or Letter (orientation from each image, or fixed) with a margin, or pages the size of each image. JPEG and PNG go in untouched; WebP and AVIF are converted to JPEG at quality 90.

tools.name: favicon_create
tools.description: Makes the usual favicon set from a logo (JPEG, PNG, WebP or AVIF): favicon.ico (16, 32, 48 px), 16/32 px PNGs, apple-touch-icon, the Android 192/512 icons and site.webmanifest, centred on a square with optional padding and background, plus the <link> tags to paste into <head>.

background.description: Hex fill behind the image (default transparent)

tools.name: gif_create
tools.description: Joins JPEG, PNG, WebP or AVIF images into an animated GIF, in the order given, each fitted (or cropped to fill) on a frame of one size.

width.description: Default: the first image, at most 800 px wide

tools.name: image_palette
tools.description: The main colours of a JPEG, PNG, WebP or AVIF image (k-means in OKLab, transparent pixels ignored), largest share first, as hex, RGB and OKLCH.

tools.name: image_metadata_read
tools.description: Shows what a photo reveals: GPS position (with a map link), camera and lens, date taken, author and copyright, software and exposure, from EXIF, XMP and IPTC in JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIC, AVIF and TIFF. Use image_strip_metadata to remove it.

tools.name: invoice_to_pdf
tools.description: Makes an A4 invoice, proforma or quote PDF: seller and buyer, dates, line items with VAT rates, totals with VAT per rate (rounded per rate, as accountants check them), payment details, notes and an optional PNG/JPEG logo. Labels and number/date formats in 14 languages. Not an e-Factura (no XML is made).

tools.name: ocr_image
tools.description: Reads the text in JPEG, PNG, WebP or AVIF images (scans, screenshots, photos of documents) with Tesseract on this machine. Languages: eng, ron, deu, fra, spa, ita, hun, por, nld, pol, ces, bul, ukr, tur (combine them, e.g. ["ron","eng"]). Low-confidence guesses are dropped; Romanian ş ţ become ș ț. The first use of a language downloads its model (2-15 MB) from app.ionelul.com and caches it; images never leave this machine.

layout.description: Join lines into paragraphs (default) or keep every line break

output.description: Write all the text to this .txt file instead of returning it

tools.name: video_convert
tools.description: Converts any video ffmpeg on this machine can read (AVI, WMV, FLV, MPEG, H.266/VVC with ffmpeg 7+…) to MP4, MOV, MKV, WebM, MPEG-TS or AVI, or extracts the sound to MP3, M4A, OGG or WAV. Picks the video codec (H.264, H.265, AV1, VP9, VP8) and audio codec, or copies the streams with no re-encode (videoCodec/audioCodec "copy", e.g. MKV to MP4). Can shrink to a maximum height (aspect kept, never enlarged), cap the frame rate, trim to a start/end and drop the sound. Needs ffmpeg installed.

format.description: Default: from the output extension, else mp4

output.description: Default: <name>.<format> next to the input (<name>-converted.<format> for the same extension)

videoCodec.description: Default: h264, or vp9 for webm; "copy" keeps the original stream

audioCodec.description: Default: the format's first (aac, opus for webm/ogg, mp3, pcm); "copy" keeps it

tools.name: video_to_gif
tools.description: Turns a clip of a video (at most 60 s) into an animated GIF with ffmpeg on this machine, using a palette made for that clip. Pick the part with start/end; frame rate and width keep the file small. Needs ffmpeg installed.

end.description: Seconds (default: the end of the video, at most 60 s after start)

tools.name: video_upscale
tools.description: Enlarges a video (or a clip of it, at most 60 s) 2x or 4x with Real-ESRGAN, frame by frame, on this machine; results up to 4K. Reads anything ffmpeg reads, including OpenCV MPEG-4 (mp4v); writes H.264 MP4 with the sound kept. Every frame goes through the model, so expect about 0.5 s per 480p frame on a recent CPU. The first call installs ONNX Runtime (about 113 MB) and downloads the model (5 MB). Needs ffmpeg installed.

model.description: general for live action (default), anime for animation (about twice as fast)

end.description: Seconds (default: the end, at most 60 s after start)

tools.name: video_frames
tools.description: Saves still images from a video with ffmpeg on this machine: one every N seconds, a set number spread over the clip, one at each scene change, or every frame (at most 500). Files are PNG, JPG or WebP named by their time (name-00m02s000.png), in a folder next to the video. Needs ffmpeg installed.

mode.description: interval: every `every` seconds; count: `count` frames spread evenly; scenes: the first frame of each shot; all: every frame

sensitivity.description: Scene detection, higher finds smaller changes (default 50)

overwrite.description: Replace frames with the same names

tools.name: video_remove_background
tools.description: Keys out a plain background (green screen, blue screen, a plain wall) with ffmpeg on this machine. The colour is found from the edges of the first frame, or given as hex. Writes a transparent WebM (VP9 with alpha, for video editors and the web) or an MP4 on a new background colour; the sound is kept. For people or objects in front of an ordinary background, use the AI version on app.ionelul.com/video-background-remover. Needs ffmpeg installed.

color.description: Background colour to remove, e.g. "#00b140" (default: detected from the frame edges)

tolerance.description: How far from the colour still counts as background (default 30)

background.description: Put the subject on this colour and write MP4; omit for a transparent WebM

output.description: Default: <name>-transparent.webm or <name>-background.mp4 next to the video

tools.name: audio_denoise
tools.description: Turns down background noise (fans, traffic, hum, keyboard) in a recording and keeps the voice, with RNNoise on this machine. Takes any audio or video ffmpeg reads; writes WAV, MP3, M4A, FLAC or OGG by the output extension (default <name>-clean.wav), or, for a video, the same video with the cleaned sound when the output is a video file. The sound comes out mono. Needs ffmpeg installed.

output.description: Default: <name>-clean.wav next to the input; a .mp4/.mov/.mkv/.webm output keeps the video

amount.description: 1 removes as much as it can (default); lower blends some of the original back

tools.name: image_upscale
tools.description: Enlarges JPEG, PNG, WebP or AVIF images 2x or 4x with Real-ESRGAN (AI that restores detail), on this machine. Transparency is kept. The first call installs ONNX Runtime (about 113 MB) and downloads the model (5 MB) into the cache.

model.description: general for photos (default), anime for drawings, cartoons and anime (faster)
